newsitem.title: FRANCE: Corsican guerrillas blast post offices.
newsitem.headline: Corsican guerrillas blast post offices.

text.p: Suspected Corsican separatists set off bombs outside six post offices through the French Mediterranean island overnight, police said on Sunday.
The blasts between just before and after midnight hit offices in Sartene, Ajaccio, Afa, Sagone, Cauro and Cargese.
The bombs were small and there were no casualties.
No one claimed responsibility for the attacks, which appeared to be part of the separatists' campaign for greater autonomy from France.

Despite a threatened crackdown on lawlessness on the holiday island, bombs have exploded virtually every night since mid-August, when one of the main separatist groups called off a shaky truce intended to foster secret talks with the government.
